decisions.reason: Audio and web conferencing is commoditised and outside Colt-type network core strengths, so it likely falls below aspiration, but with no clear failure signal and enough slack to carry it, it is kept for now.
The metro data centre network has a concrete adoption result in the financial hub, which exceeds aspiration and fits the core infrastructure strategy.
Optical spectrum services sit at the heart of the firm's high-bandwidth network business and were given a dedicated page, signalling strategic commitment.
The number ordering portal is a low-cost support tool for the voice business that improves efficiency, so there is little reason for problemistic search.
Carrier pre-selection is a declining legacy telephony service likely to underperform aspirations, but it still generates residual revenue at low cost and is kept for another year.
Direct voice network connection (SIP-style) matches enterprise demand for IP voice migration and fits the core portfolio.
